item: The provenance label follows the export for repaired rows; a recorded repair run is never overwritten (diagnostics rank 14, late review items of #1288 and #1294)
status: SHIPPED (field effect at each instance's next start)
key_paths: src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; src/catalog/qualification_export.py; src/discovery/source_trail.py; tests/test_qualification_auto_repair.py; tests/test_curated_catalog_stamp.py; tests/test_qualification_recheck_first.py
summary: GET /api/sources/{id}/provenance called a row the boot repair withdrew measured; it now reads inherited under the export's own check (repair_still_followed: the newest judging attempt is still the imported one the repair followed). repaired_rows no longer falls back to an older record once the newest record of a domain is reverted. A repair at the instant of an already recorded run (readable or not) waits for the clock instead of overwriting it and its revert record. OPEN_QUEUE says any newer judging attempt makes a repaired row measured. Tests pin each, plus newest-wins, a record without judged_at, the count kept across boots, and the try of a flagged source taken from a pool past the slice; each fix has a test that fails when it is removed.
